# Yum X - Food Delivery Dashboard

## Project Overview
Yum X is a modern food delivery and restaurant management dashboard built with:
- **Next.js 14** with TypeScript
- **Tailwind CSS** for styling
- **shadcn/ui** components
- **React** for UI components

## Key Features
- Dashboard with analytics and metrics
- Order management system
- Customer management
- Chef/Kitchen management
- Sales analytics with charts
- Real-time activities feed
- Menu submission system

## Architecture
- Modern React components with TypeScript
- Server-side rendering with Next.js
- Responsive design with Tailwind CSS
- Reusable UI components from shadcn/ui
- Clean component structure

## Development Guidelines
- Use TypeScript for all components
- Follow shadcn/ui component patterns
- Implement responsive design
- Use proper React hooks and patterns
- Maintain clean code structure
